title: finalise runs after a failed execute, and withholds the contract the engine did return.
why: behavioural spec 'finalise': it writes nothing, and fails naming the interactions, when any 'execute' in the session failed — even though the engine returned a contract: only the closure knows whether the consumer handled what it was sent, and a contract must not claim a variant the consumer's own test failed on (Phase 9 finding 4). The integration MUST run 'finalise' after the suite's last 'execute', including when an 'execute' failed: sessions are the only resource (engine-protocol spec §7.1).
